factories.name: new_list_items_step
factories.description: List one bounded page of a board's active items that match a typed column-value filter, continuing with monday.com's items_page cursor.

ItemFilter.description: ItemFilter is a typed items_page filter: rules on column values joined by Combination. The zero value matches every active item on the board.

combination.description: Combination joins the rules; blank means every rule must match.

rules.description: Rules are at most 10 column conditions.

ItemFilterRule.description: ItemFilterRule is one condition on a column's value. Values carry string compare values in monday.com's per-column format, such as an exact item name for the name column, ["EXACT", "2026-07-01"] or ["TODAY"] for a date column, or "person-48202303" for a people column. Numbers carry numeric compare values, such as status label indexes. Set at most one of the two: ItemFilterIsEmpty and ItemFilterIsNotEmpty take neither; contains_text, not_contains_text, contains_terms, starts_with, and ends_with take exactly one string; between takes exactly two; the other operators take 1 to 50. An unsupported combination selects defect before any request is sent.

columnId.description: ColumnID is the column to compare, such as status or date4; name compares the item name.

compareAttribute.description: CompareAttribute optionally names the column attribute monday.com compares, such as a people column's attribute.

numbers.description: Numbers are numeric compare values, such as status label indexes.

operator.description: Operator is the comparison; blank means any_of.

ItemOrder.description: ItemOrder orders a listing by one column or timestamp.

columnId.description: ColumnID is the column to order by, or ItemOrderCreationTime or ItemOrderLastUpdated.

descending.description: IsDescending orders from the largest or latest value.

inputSchema.description: ListItemsInput selects one page of a board's active items. The first page sets BoardID with an optional Filter and Order; a later page sets BoardID and the previous page's NextCursor only, because monday.com's cursor carries the filter and rejects a new one.

boardId.description: BoardID is the numeric board ID, the number after /boards/ in the board's URL.

columnIds.description: ColumnIDs limits each item's column values to at most 50 columns; empty returns every column.

cursor.description: Cursor continues a listing with the previous page's NextCursor; monday.com expires it 60 minutes after the first page.

filter.description: Filter limits the page to items whose column values match; the zero value lists every active item.

limit.description: Limit is the page size from 1 to 100; zero means 25.

order.description: Order orders the listing by one column or timestamp; nil keeps monday.com's board order.

factories.name: new_get_item_step
factories.description: Read one item by ID with its group, timestamps, and the text and JSON value of every requested column.

columnIds.description: ColumnIDs limits the column values to at most 50 columns; empty returns every column.

includesInactive.description: IncludesInactive also returns an archived or deleted item, with its State, instead of notFound.

itemId.description: ItemID is the numeric item ID, such as the ID listItems returns.

factories.name: new_create_item_step
factories.description: Create one item on a board with typed column values. A stable Idempotency-Key and sync dispatch checkpoint fence retries; an unconfirmed sent request fails closed.

ColumnValue.description: ColumnValue is one typed value written to a monday.com column. Type selects which fields apply: Text for text and long_text; Number for numbers; StatusLabel or StatusIndex for status; Date and the optional Time for date; PersonIDs and TeamIDs for people; Checked for checkbox; Email with the optional Text for email; URL with the optional Text for link; Phone and CountryCode for phone; DropdownLabels or DropdownLabelIDs for dropdown; and Date and EndDate for timeline. Setting a field that does not belong to Type selects defect before any request is sent. Prefer the constructors such as TextValue and StatusLabelValue, and ClearedValue to empty a column on purpose. Writes replace the column's whole value: a people or dropdown value lists every entry the column keeps, so repeating the same write leaves the item unchanged.

checked.description: Checked is a checkbox value; false clears the checkbox.

cleared.description: IsCleared empties the column; no other field may be set.

countryCode.description: CountryCode is the phone number's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as US.

date.description: Date is a YYYY-MM-DD date, or the start of a timeline.

dropdownLabelIds.description: DropdownLabelIDs selects dropdown labels by their numeric IDs.

dropdownLabels.description: DropdownLabels selects dropdown labels by their text.

email.description: Email is a bare email address such as jane@example.com.

endDate.description: EndDate is the YYYY-MM-DD end of a timeline, on or after Date.

number.description: Number is a finite numbers value.

personIds.description: PersonIDs lists monday.com user IDs of a people value.

phone.description: Phone is a phone number of 4 to 20 digits with an optional leading +.

statusIndex.description: StatusIndex selects a status label by its index; monday.com recommends it for numeric labels.

statusLabel.description: StatusLabel selects a status label by its text, such as Done.

teamIds.description: TeamIDs lists monday.com team IDs of a people value.

text.description: Text is the text of a text or long_text value, or the display text of an email or link.

time.description: Time is an optional HH:MM:SS UTC time for a date value.

type.description: Type is the column's monday.com type.

url.description: URL is an absolute http or https link.

boardId.description: BoardID is the numeric board ID, the number after /boards/ in the board's URL.

columnValues.description: ColumnValues maps at most 50 column IDs, such as status or date4, to typed values.

createsLabelsIfMissing.description: CreatesLabelsIfMissing lets monday.com add a missing status or dropdown label, which needs permission to change the board structure; false rejects an unknown label.

groupId.description: GroupID places the item in this group, such as topics; blank uses the board's first active group.

itemName.description: ItemName is the item name, 1 to 255 characters on one line.

inputSchema.description: UpdateItemColumnValuesInput sets absolute values on columns of one item. Columns left out keep their values.

boardId.description: BoardID is the numeric ID of the board that holds the item.

columnValues.description: ColumnValues maps 1 to 50 column IDs, such as status or date4, to typed values.

createsLabelsIfMissing.description: CreatesLabelsIfMissing lets monday.com add a missing status or dropdown label, which needs permission to change the board structure; false rejects an unknown label.

itemId.description: ItemID is the numeric item ID.

factories.name: new_add_update_step
factories.description: Add one plain-text item update. A stable Idempotency-Key and sync dispatch checkpoint fence retries; an unconfirmed sent request fails closed.

inputSchema.description: AddUpdateInput is one update, monday.com's comment on an item.

body.description: Body is plain text of at most 10,000 characters. The connector escapes it into monday.com's HTML update body, so markup is shown literally and line breaks are kept.

itemId.description: ItemID is the numeric ID of the item to comment on.
